headline: IMF flags AI share crash; Anthropic nears Japan data centre
body: A quiet day. The IMF named an AI equity correction as one of three top risks to global financial stability, a small knock to Shared Prosperity that trims Egalitarian Utopia. NTT Data entered final talks to build a 500MW data centre in Osaka for Anthropic, with partial operations targeted for 2028, a slight boost to capability. Horizon Balance ended at -8.12.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Egalitarian Utopia -0.08, from the IMF warning (-0.10), partly offset by fading earlier news (+0.03); Self-Destruction -0.04, from fading earlier news (-0.04).
coming_up: 2028: partial operations targeted for Anthropic's Osaka data center with NTT Data
